note: Kay County has no public zoning district service found in ArcGIS search or web search. Ponca City, the largest city, publishes its zoning only as a static 2024 PDF map (poncacityok.gov DocumentCenter 6557) and code tables (amlegal Chapter 3). Newkirk, Blackwell and Tonkawa showed no zoning GIS. Kay County Assessor's mapping page lists no zoning REST endpoint. No queryable zoning polygons exist publicly.
